content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00078 If a data element has been invalidated in case of Intra-ECU communication and the attribute handleInvalid is set to keep – the query of the value shall return the same value as if COM would have handled the invalidation (copy COM behavior). Then the reception of the invalid value will be handled as an error and the activation of runnable entities can be performed using the DataReceiveErrorEvent .
